array.string: app="${MAGI_APP_ROOT:-$HOME/Library/Application Support/MAGI}"; runtime="$app/runtime/MAGI_v3/shared"; launcher="${MAGI_ACTIVE_SERVICE_LAUNCHER:-$app/bin/magi-active-release-service.py}"; python="${MAGI_ACTIVE_SERVICE_PYTHON:-/usr/bin/python3}"; test -f "$launcher" && test -x "$python" || exit 78; export MAGI_RUNTIME_DIR="${MAGI_RUNTIME_DIR:-$runtime/runtime}" MAGI_AGENT_DIR="${MAGI_AGENT_DIR:-$runtime/agent}" MAGI_DATA_DIR="${MAGI_DATA_DIR:-$runtime/agent}" MAGI_LOG_DIR="${MAGI_LOG_DIR:-$app/runtime/MAGI_v3/logs/share-tunnel}" MAGI_ENV_FILE="${MAGI_ENV_FILE:-$runtime/external/.env}" MAGI_OSC_FILE_SHARE_PUBLIC_BASE_FILE="${MAGI_OSC_FILE_SHARE_PUBLIC_BASE_FILE:-$runtime/runtime/osc_share_public_base_url.txt}"; exec "$python" "$launcher" paperclip-share-tunnel
